explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/819: 'Estimate f(N)', with known bounds (3/8 - o(1))N ≤ f(N) ≤ (1/2 + o(1))N. The statement asks for an answer function with f ~ answer. That is a strong reading of 'estimate': it amounts to determining the exact asymptotic constant, if one exists. It is a defensible interpretation but stronger than the vague source wording, which could be satisfied by improved bounds. The definition of f is faithful.
